title: Running spend
prompt: The banking app shows how much each account has spent so far after every payment. Write `solve(transactions)` so it returns each posted debit with the account's running spend up to and including it.
rules: Only rows with `direction` `debit` and `status` `posted` count. Leave out credits and pending or declined rows.
Within each `account_id`, go in `posted_at` order. Two debits at the same moment go in `transaction_id` order, so their running totals differ.
`spend_so_far` is the sum of `amount` from the account's first debit up to this one. Rows with a missing `account_id` form one group of their own.
hints: Filter first, then add the running total with `F.sum("amount").over(w)`.
Order the window by `posted_at` and then `transaction_id`, so no two rows tie.
Give the window a frame: `.rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)`.
starter:
